grid_random_coordinate_gradient_bayesian: ran: compact global SURE and oracle-MSE searches; results in summary.csv and search_comparison.csv
brisque_niqe_quality_only: ran: 125-point coefficient grid; invalid BRISQUE/NIQE candidate scores penalized and counted in nr_metric_failures.json
risk_constrained_quality: ran: global and per-image BRISQUE/NIQE rank-affinity selection with a SURE risk ceiling
discriminator_guided_coefficients: ran: epoch-100 checkpoint; 8 images, 128px crops, 8 optimizer steps/image; smoke-test pilot only
archive_faithful_discriminator_coefficie: ran: epoch-100 clean checkpoint; archive Gabor bands and abs-normalized coefficients; 150 steps/image, with and without mean constraint; 4 clipped-AWGN crops per dataset
public_nima_technical_coefficients: ran: public NIMA technical MobileNet weights trained on TID2013; archive bands; 150 steps/image; same 8 clipped-AWGN crops as discriminator comparison; results in nima_technical/
public_nima_technical_100_crops: ran: 50 CBSD68 plus 50 Kodak24 reproducible 128px crops; clipped AWGN sigma 25/255 before fitting; 150 steps; clean/noisy/restored images and metrics in nima_technical_100/
nima_vs_discriminator_100_crops: ran: paired comparison on the exact same 100 noisy crops; epoch-100 archive discriminator versus public NIMA technical guidance; paired metrics and discriminator images in discriminator_100/
salt_pepper_100_crops: ran: 10% whole-pixel salt-and-pepper noise on 100 crops; NIMA and archive-discriminator guidance versus 3x3/5x5 median; mismatched Gaussian-SURE diagnostic and clean-reference three-band oracle recorded in salt_pepper_100/
hits_filter_ensemble: ran: 9-filter global ensemble fitted on 16 DIV2K validation crops; frozen evaluation on 8 CBSD68 and 8 Kodak24 crops
noise_model: synthetic unclipped AWGN, sigma=25/255; restored images clipped for display-domain metrics
calibration: 16 DIV2K validation images, random 128px crops; separate HITS fit uses its recorded 16-image calibration set
evaluation: pilot subsets only: coefficient search uses 8 CBSD68 and 8 Kodak24 images with 192px crops; NR and discriminator runs use 8 and 4 images per set respectively
runtime: verified in .venv: Python 3.14, PyTorch 2.14.0+cpu, torchvision 0.29.0, PyIQA 0.1.16
